title: Take It Slow (Bullit) - Robin Schulz / Watermat

lines.l: How does it feel when you're meant for more?
And it feels on hold
We should take it slow
Oh, oh, oh, oh
So we take it slow
And it feels like home
All you need is here, never let it go
Hold on more than ever let it
Open your heart, oh can't you see
Flowers all around, they make you feel
Like there's so much more to life
Make it through the noise, look up and breathe
Think of all the moments you couldn't feel
They're right in front of you
We should take it slow
All you need is here, now let it go
Hold the moment, never let it go
I've been going, I've been going
Back to yours
I've been fighting
